definitions.explanation: Sleeping longer than intended, especially past the time one should wake up.
A person who tends to sleep late or oversleep.

examples.japanese: {寝坊|ねぼう}して{学校|がっこう}に{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I overslept and was late for school.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{寝坊|ねぼう}しないようにアラームをセットした。
examples.english: I set an alarm so I won't oversleep tomorrow.

examples.japanese: うちの{子|こ}は{寝坊|ねぼう}です。
examples.english: My child is a late riser.
examples.notes: Sense 2: as a noun for a person

examples.japanese: {日曜日|にちようび}は{寝坊|ねぼう}してもいい。
examples.english: It's okay to sleep in on Sunday.

examples.japanese: {弟|おとうと}は{寝坊|ねぼう}だから{朝|あさ}は{起|お}こさないといけない。
examples.english: My younger brother is a late riser, so I have to wake him up in the morning.

examples.japanese: {寝坊|ねぼう}して{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}を{食|た}べられなかった。
examples.english: I overslept and couldn't eat breakfast.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{有名|ゆうめい}な{寝坊|ねぼう}だ。
examples.english: That person is a well-known late riser.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}だったので{寝坊|ねぼう}した。
examples.english: I slept late because it was a holiday.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{昔|むかし}から{寝坊|ねぼう}だった。
examples.english: I've been a late riser since long ago.

examples.japanese: {寝坊|ねぼう}して{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: I overslept and missed the train.

notes:
{寝坊|ねぼう} is composed of {寝|ね} (sleep) + {坊|ぼう} (person, in compounds).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {寝坊|ねぼう}する: to oversleep
- {寝坊|ねぼう}して{遅刻|ちこく}する: to be late due to oversleeping
- {寝坊|ねぼう}しないように: so as not to oversleep

RELATED TERMS:
- {遅刻|ちこく}: being late
- {早起|はやお}き: early riser, waking up early
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}: morning oversleeping
- {二度寝|にどね}: going back to sleep

OPPOSITE: {早起|はやお}き (early riser)
